opt: (A) relocated — (B) collective — (C) reluctantly
(A) discarded — (B) private — (C) reluctantly
(A) relocated — (B) private — (C) persistently
(A) discarded — (B) collective — (C) persistently

choice.ex: (A) relocated (B) collective (C) persistently 근거 ❷❹❾ 해설: (A) ❷ moved one by one, directly next to a newly planted oak tree = 옮겨지다 / (B) ❹ community participation was essential = 집단적 노력 / (C) ❾ held on to his faith and continued to make efforts = 끈질기게. discarded는 돌을 버린다는 뜻, private는 ❸❹의 '모든 사람'과 반대, reluctantly는 ❾와 모순. 요약문 해석: Beuys는 주민들 스스로가 프로젝트를 수행하도록 그것을 설계했다. 현무암 돌 더미가 광장에서 기다렸고, 각 돌은 새로 심어진 참나무 옆으로 (A) 옮겨질 예정이었다. 프로젝트가 (B) 집단적인 노력에 달려 있다고 확신했기에, 그는 초기의 회의론이 자신을 멈추게 두지 않았고, 대신 사람들의 마음을 얻기 위 해 (C) 끈질기게 노력했다.
choice.psg: ❶ After he planted the first tree and placed the first basalt column beside it, he brought 6,999 more basalt columns and piled them up in a public square in front of the museum. ❷ The stones would be moved one by one, directly next to a newly planted oak tree at its new site. ❸ He urged everyone to plant their own oak tree and to place one of the basalt columns next to it. ❹ Beuys believed that community participation was essential to the project’s success. ❺ At first, the 7000 Oaks project was met with controversy and opposition. ❻ It was financially supported by the city of Kassel and its mayor, but some people protested against spending taxpayers’ money on such a “useless” project. ❼ They complained that it was pointless to plant trees in a city. ❽ Above all, people questioned whether 7,000 trees could successfully be planted in the city. ❾ However, Beuys held on to his faith and continued to make efforts to reach out to as many individuals as possible to include them in the project. ❿ He held workshops to educate people about the project’s importance and how they could contribute. ⓫ He even talked to people one on one about the project and encouraged them to take part. ⓬ His message to the people of Kassel was that everyone had the ability to make a difference.
choice.body: Beuys designed the project so that residents themselves would carry it out: a pile of basalt stones waited in a square, and each stone was to be (A)________ beside a newly planted oak. Convinced that the project depended on (B)________ effort, he did not let early skepticism stop him; instead, he worked (C)________ to win people over.

choice.psg: ❶ After he planted the first tree and placed the first basalt column beside it, he brought 6,999 more basalt columns and piled them up in a public square in front of the museum. ❷ The stones would be moved one by one, directly next to a newly planted oak tree at its new site. ❸ He urged everyone to plant their own oak tree and to place one of the basalt columns next to it. ❹ Beuys believed that community participation was essential to the project’s success. ❺ At first, the 7000 Oaks project was met with controversy and opposition. ❻ It was financially supported by the city of Kassel and its mayor, but some people protested against spending taxpayers’ money on such a “useless” project. ❼ They complained that it was pointless to plant trees in a city. ❽ Above all, people questioned whether 7,000 trees could successfully be planted in the city. ❾ However, Beuys held on to his faith and continued to make efforts to reach out to as many individuals as possible to include them in the project. ❿ He held workshops to educate people about the project’s importance and how they could contribute. ⓫ He even talked to people one on one about the project and encouraged them to take part. ⓬ His message to the people of Kassel was that everyone had the ability to make a difference.
choice.body: At first, many people in Kassel considered the project a (A)________ use of public money and doubted that so many trees could ever take root in the city. Beuys, however, refused to (B)________; he personally explained to residents how they could help, insisting that every individual had the power to (C)________ their city.

choice.ex: ❻은 카셀시와 시장이 재정적으로 지원했다고만 하며, 지원을 철회했다는 내용은 없음(원문 밖 인과). 나머지는 ❷❸ / ❻ / ❿⓫ / ❽에 서 추론 가능. ① 근거 ❽ — 일부 사람들은 그렇게 많은 수의 나무가 실제로 심어질 수 있을지에 대해 회의적이었다. ② 근거 ❷❸ — Beuys는 돌의 배치가 주민들이 나무를 심기로 선택한 장소에 따라 정해지도록 의도했다. ③ 근거 없음(정답) — 카셀시는 주민들이 비용에 대해 불평하기 시작하자 재정적 지원을 철회했다. ④ 근거 ❻ — 카셀의 모든 사람이 나무 심기 프로젝트에 시 자금을 쓰는 생각을 반긴 것은 아니었다. ⑤ 근거 ❿⓫ — Beuys는 개인적인 접촉이 주민들의 참여를 장려하는 효과적인 방법이라고 여겼다.
choice.psg: ❶ After he planted the first tree and placed the first basalt column beside it, he brought 6,999 more basalt columns and piled them up in a public square in front of the museum. ❷ The stones would be moved one by one, directly next to a newly planted oak tree at its new site. ❸ He urged everyone to plant their own oak tree and to place one of the basalt columns next to it. ❹ Beuys believed that community participation was essential to the project’s success. ❺ At first, the 7000 Oaks project was met with controversy and opposition. ❻ It was financially supported by the city of Kassel and its mayor, but some people protested against spending taxpayers’ money on such a “useless” project. ❼ They complained that it was pointless to plant trees in a city. ❽ Above all, people questioned whether 7,000 trees could successfully be planted in the city. ❾ However, Beuys held on to his faith and continued to make efforts to reach out to as many individuals as possible to include them in the project. ❿ He held workshops to educate people about the project’s importance and how they could contribute. ⓫ He even talked to people one on one about the project and encouraged them to take part. ⓬ His message to the people of Kassel was that everyone had the ability to make a difference.

choice.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
opt: a project that some people saw as a waste of public money, though the writer does not share that view
a project that had already failed to attract any funding from the city
a project that was too small to change the landscape of Kassel

choice.ex: 밑줄 해석: 그런 ‘쓸모없는’ 프로젝트 — 반대하는 사람들이 쓸모없다고 여긴 프로젝트 해설: 따옴표 “useless”는 필자가 아니라 세금 사용에 항의한 일부 사람들의 시각임을 표시함 — ❼ pointless가 그 시각을 풀어 줌. ②는 ❻ 재정 지원 사실과 모순, ③은 시가 오히려 지원함, ④는 Beuys의 신념(❾)과 반대, ⑤는 7,000그루 규모와 무관. ① 일부 사람들이 공금 낭비로 여긴 프로젝트(필자는 그 견해에 동의하지 않음) ② 이미 시로부터 어떤 자금도 끌어오지 못한 프로젝트 ③ 카셀의 경관을 바꾸기에는 너무 작은 프로젝트 ④ Beuys가 시민들에게 실질적 이익을 주지 못할 것이라고 인정한 프로젝트 ⑤ 시 공무원들 스스로 예술적 가치가 거의 없다고 여긴 프로젝트
choice.body: At first, the 7000 Oaks project was met with controversy and opposition. It was financially supported by the city of Kassel and its mayor, but some people protested against spending taxpayers’ money on such a “useless” project. They complained that it was pointless to plant trees in a city.

choice.ex: (A) warmed to (B) tended (C) bonded 근거 ❶❹❼ 해설: (A) ❶ changed their minds … joined him = 프로젝트에 호감을 갖게 됨 / (B) ❹❺ 심은 뒤 물 주기·가지치기·보호 = 돌봄 / (C) ❻❼ 처음 만난 사람 들이 함께 일함 = 결속. turned against·neglected·divided·isolated는 모두 원문과 반대 방향. 요약문 해석: Beuys의 끈질긴 설득 활동에 마음이 움직여, 점점 더 많은 카셀 주민들이 그 프로젝트에 (A) 호감을 갖게 되었다. 그들의 참여는 심는 일을 훨씬 넘어섰다. 그들은 장소도 제공했고 이후 어린 나무들을 (B) 돌보았다. 결국 그 프로젝트는 낯선 사이였던 사람들을 (C) 결속시켜, 그들에게 공유된 소속감을 주 었다.
choice.psg: ❶ Through his tireless efforts to spread his message, an increasing number of Kassel residents changed their minds about the project and joined him in planting trees. ❷ The community’s involvement did not end with the planting of the trees. ❸ Residents, community councils, schools, local associations, and others provided planting sites. ❹ People took care of the trees after they were planted. ❺ They watered, trimmed, and protected the trees from harm. ❻ The project brought the community together during the process. ❼ People who had never met before were inclined to work together to plant trees. ❽ They shared a common goal and worked towards it. ❾ The project gave the residents of Kassel a sense of community and belonging.
choice.body: Persuaded by Beuys's persistent outreach, a growing number of Kassel residents (A)________ the project. Their participation went well beyond planting: they also supplied sites and (B)________ the young trees afterward. In the end, the project (C)________ people who had been strangers, giving them a shared sense of belonging.

choice.stem: 다음 요약문의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

choice.psg: ❶ Through his tireless efforts to spread his message, an increasing number of Kassel residents changed their minds about the project and joined him in planting trees. ❷ The community’s involvement did not end with the planting of the trees. ❸ Residents, community councils, schools, local associations, and others provided planting sites. ❹ People took care of the trees after they were planted. ❺ They watered, trimmed, and protected the trees from harm. ❻ The project brought the community together during the process. ❼ People who had never met before were inclined to work together to plant trees. ❽ They shared a common goal and worked towards it. ❾ The project gave the residents of Kassel a sense of community and belonging.
choice.body: Even after planting, the residents' involvement (A)________, as people kept looking after the trees. In the process, those who had once been strangers became willing (B)________, and the project finally gave them a feeling that they truly (C)________ as members of their city.

choice.stem: 위 글의 내용으로부터 추론할 수 없는 것을 고르시오.
opt: Working on the project helped people who were once strangers develop ties with one another.
Beuys’s persistence in spreading his message played a role in winning over local residents.
The city council paid residents a fee for each tree they agreed to look after.
Various local organizations, not just individuals, contributed to the project by offering places to plant.
The residents’ involvement included maintaining the trees after they had been planted.
choice.ex: 원문은 주민들의 자발적 참여만 말할 뿐, 시 의회의 수수료 지급(금전 보상)은 전혀 언급하지 않음(원문 밖 정보). 나머지는 ❶ / ❸ / ❹❺ / ❻❼❾에서 추론 가능. ① 근거 ❻❼❾ — 그 프로젝트에 참여한 것은 한때 낯선 사이였던 사람들이 서로 유대를 쌓도록 도왔다. ② 근거 ❶ — 메시지를 전파하려는 Beuys의 끈기는 지역 주민들의 마음을 얻는 데 한몫했다. ③ 근거 없음(정답) — 시 의회는 주민들이 돌보기로 동의한 나무 한 그루당 수수료를 지급했다. ④ 근거 ❸ — 개인뿐 아니라 다양한 지역 단체도 심을 장소를 제공함으로써 프로젝트에 기여했다. ⑤ 근거 ❹❺ — 주민들의 참여에는 나무가 심어진 후 그것을 관리하는 일도 포함되었다.
choice.psg: ❶ Through his tireless efforts to spread his message, an increasing number of Kassel residents changed their minds about the project and joined him in planting trees. ❷ The community’s involvement did not end with the planting of the trees. ❸ Residents, community councils, schools, local associations, and others provided planting sites. ❹ People took care of the trees after they were planted. ❺ They watered, trimmed, and protected the trees from harm. ❻ The project brought the community together during the process. ❼ People who had never met before were inclined to work together to plant trees. ❽ They shared a common goal and worked towards it. ❾ The project gave the residents of Kassel a sense of community and belonging.

choice.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

moved people from different neighborhoods to live closer to the trees
caused disagreements among residents about where to plant trees

gathered citizens in one place to watch Beuys plant the trees
choice.ex: 밑줄 해석: 그 프로젝트는 그 과정 동안 지역사회를 하나로 합쳤다(결속시켰다). 해설: 'bring ~ together'는 '(사람들을) 하나로 결속시키다'. 바로 뒤 ❼ 처음 만난 사람들이 함께 일하려 했다는 내용이 의미를 풀어 줌. ②③은 together의 물 리적 '모임·이동' 의미를 이용한 함정, ④⑤는 무관하거나 반대. ① 주민들을 공유된 목적을 향해 협력하는 하나의 결속된 집단으로 만들었다 ② 여러 동네의 사람들을 나무 가까이에 살도록 이주시켰다 ③ 나무를 어디에 심을지를 두고 주민들 사이에 의견 충돌을 일으켰다 ④ 지역사회가 지원을 시 정부에 의존하게 만들었다 ⑤ Beuys가 나무 심는 것을 지켜보도록 시민들을 한 장소에 모았다
choice.body: They watered, trimmed, and protected the trees from harm. The project brought the community together during the process. People who had never met before were inclined to work together to plant trees.

(A) final wishes — (B) devoted cooperation — (C) cherished

choice.ex: (A) final wishes (B) devoted cooperation (C) cherished 근거 ❸❻❽ 해설: (A) ❸ As a legacy of his will = 그의 유언(마지막 소원) / (B) ❻ 주민들의 적극적인 참여 없이는 실현 불가 = 헌신적인 협력 / (C) ❽ 번성하며 전 세계 방문객에게 영감 = 소중한. artistic fame은 근거 없음, official funding은 이 글에 없는 내용, neglected·temporary는 ❽❾와 반대. 요약문 해석: Beuys는 나무 심기가 끝나기 전에 세상을 떠났지만, 그의 가족과 동료 시민들은 그의 (A) 마지막 소원을 기리는 방식으로 그의 일을 이어 갔다. 1987년에 완성된 이 프로젝트는 그 성공을 지역 주민들의 (B) 헌신적인 협력 덕분으로 돌렸고, 오늘날 참나무들은 전 세계에서 사람들을 계속 끌어들이는 (C) 소중한 존재로 남아 있다.
choice.psg: ❶ By 1986, approximately 5,500 trees had been planted. ❷ Unfortunately, Joseph Beuys died at the age of sixty-four, before his final project was completed. ❸ As a legacy of his will, his family and the citizens continued to plant the remaining trees. ❹ Finally, his son, Wenzel Beuys, planted the final tree in 1987. ❺ The massive project took five years to complete. ❻ The project would not have been realized without the active participation of the Kassel residents. ❼ Rows of large oak trees now provide spectacular views in and around Kassel. ❽ The 7000 Oaks project has flourished and continues to inspire Kassel residents and visitors from all over the world. ❾ The trees are now a vital part of the city’s landscape, providing a green and peaceful shelter in the heart of the city. ❿ The 7000 Oaks project began with one person, but it became a collaborative work by the whole community, planting not only trees, but also community spirit. ⓫ Thanks to this project, people were able to make a significant difference to their society.
choice.body: Although Beuys passed away before the planting was finished, his family and fellow citizens carried on his work as a way of honoring his (A)________. para.en: ❶ Kassel is a small city located in central Germany. ❷ If you walk around Kassel, you will encounter rows of oak trees with stone columns beside them. ❸ This all began with a prominent German artist named Joseph Beuys, who came up with the idea to plant 7,000 oak trees throughout the city. ❹ “Seven trees do not make a forest, and neither do seventy, but seven thousand are a bit closer,” said Beuys. ❺ Despite numerous challenges, he remained firm in his determination to have 7,000 trees planted. ❻ Thanks to him, these days, the people of Kassel enjoy magnificent oak trees throughout their city. ❼ During the dreadful World War II, Kassel was the heart of German military production. ❽ This resulted in the entire city being bombed to the ground and destroyed. ❾ After the war ended, Kassel started to recover from the adversities of the war. ❿ It went through rapid industrialization and urbanization. ⓫ This provided convenience for the citizens but caused significant environmental damage, too.

❶ In 1982, Beuys was invited to show his work in an exhibition in Kassel. ❷ Beuys saw the environmental damage and thought about what he could do to advocate for nature through his work. ❸ He wanted to speak about the need to turn destructive energy for waging wars into a constructive one to build a better society. ❹ In addition, Beuys, who was deeply aware of the importance of preserving and restoring nature, wished to reshape the relationship between humans and nature. ❺ To make this happen, he proposed the project, “7000 Oaks.” ❻ In this ambitious project, he intended to plant 7,000 oak trees throughout Kassel, each paired with a basalt column. ❼ Beuys started the 7000 Oaks project by planting a small oak tree with a basalt column in front of an art museum. ❽ The oak tree illustrated nature’s constant growth, while the basalt column signified a man-made structure that remains constant. ❾ He sought to demonstrate that man-made buildings and nature could coexist in harmony by contrasting the oak tree with the basalt column. ❿ Beuys did not intend to plant all the trees by himself. ⓫ He wanted to invite the citizens of Kassel to participate in the planting of the trees.

❶ After he planted the first tree and placed the first basalt column beside it, he brought 6,999 more basalt columns and piled them up in a public square in front of the museum. ❷ The stones would be moved one by one, directly next to a newly planted oak tree at its new site. ❸ He urged everyone to plant their own oak tree and to place one of the basalt columns next to it. ❹ Beuys believed that community participation was essential to the project’s success. ❺ At first, the 7000 Oaks project was met with controversy and opposition. ❻ It was financially supported by the city of Kassel and its mayor, but some people protested against spending taxpayers’ money on such a “useless” project. ❼ They complained that it was pointless to plant trees in a city. ❽ Above all, people questioned whether 7,000 trees could successfully be planted in the city. ❾ However, Beuys held on to his faith and continued to make efforts to reach out to as many individuals as possible to include them in the project. ❿ He held workshops to educate people about the project’s importance and how they could contribute. ⓫ He even talked to people one on one about the project and encouraged them to take part. ⓬ His message to the people of Kassel was that everyone had the ability to make a difference.

❶ Through his tireless efforts to spread his message, an increasing number of Kassel residents changed their minds about the project and joined him in planting trees. ❷ The community’s involvement did not end with the planting of the trees. ❸ Residents, community councils, schools, local associations, and others provided planting sites. ❹ People took care of the trees after they were planted. ❺ They watered, trimmed, and protected the trees from harm. ❻ The project brought the community together during the process. ❼ People who had never met before were inclined to work together to plant trees. ❽ They shared a common goal and worked towards it. ❾ The project gave the residents of Kassel a sense of community and belonging.

❶ By 1986, approximately 5,500 trees had been planted. ❷ Unfortunately, Joseph Beuys died at the age of sixty-four, before his final project was completed. ❸ As a legacy of his will, his family and the citizens continued to plant the remaining trees. ❹ Finally, his son, Wenzel Beuys, planted the final tree in 1987. ❺ The massive project took five years to complete. ❻ The project would not have been realized without the active participation of the Kassel residents. ❼ Rows of large oak trees now provide spectacular views in and around Kassel. ❽ The 7000 Oaks project has flourished and continues to inspire Kassel residents and visitors from all over the world. ❾ The trees are now a vital part of the city’s landscape, providing a green and peaceful shelter in the heart of the city. ❿ The 7000 Oaks project began with one person, but it became a collaborative work by the whole community, planting not only trees, but also community spirit. ⓫ Thanks to this project, people were able to make a significant difference to their society.
